# CANDIDATE: ShotgunScalperStage5_Keeper1

## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage5 strategy attempts to capture quick scalps in 0DTE SPY options by using tight profit targets (75% of premium) and stop losses (35% of premium), combined with a 12-minute time stop and a chandelier profit lock that arms at 60% of premium. The hypothesis is that this approach avoids the large loser days identified in J's edge while capturing consistent small gains.

## Mechanism

Enter on a signal generated by the shotgun_scalper setup (likely based on volume ratio and price action) when the vol_ratio_threshold (1.2) is met. Exit at the first of:  
- Premium reaches 75% of entry premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75)  
- Premium drops to 35% below entry premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35)  
- 12 minutes elapse without hitting either target (time_stop_min=12)  
Additionally, a chandelier profit lock arms when the premium reaches 60% of entry premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6) and trails the high-water mark by 40% to lock in gains.
